title: Kenya Signs AI Cooperation Deal with Anthropic

title: Musk predicts all compute will move to space amid Google's AI plan
description: Elon Musk predicts all compute will eventually be in space. His company, SpaceX, plans to launch AI computers for its Starmind concept, while Google's Project Suncatcher will test its own AI hardware in orbit for scalable data centers.

title: BLUECLOUDS wins AI infra deal of USD 15.5M from IBM Cloud Inc.
description: Blue Cloud Softech Solutions announced that its wholly owned US subsidiary, Global Impx Inc. (GIX), has received a signed Statement of Work from IBM Cloud Inc. for AI infrastructure design, deployment and support services, at a fixed fee of US$15.5 million (approximately Rs 147 crore).
